classes.name: Player
classes.description: A tenant who owns planets and fleets.

classes.name: Planet
classes.description: An owned world. Hidden from other tenants unless allied or cleared.

classes.name: Marking
classes.description: Classification and compartments on a fact, plan, report or law.

classes.name: Compartment
classes.description: A need-to-know label that a clearance must include.

classes.name: Clearance
classes.description: Highest classification and compartments a role or leader may see.

classes.name: SharingAgreement
classes.description: Allied-faction access to marked objects at a stated class and compartment set.

classes.name: Region
classes.description: A market venue keyed by a star-system coordinate.

classes.name: Good
classes.description: A traded resource priced in metal.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: A limit or market bid or ask on a regional book.

classes.name: Contract
classes.description: A delivery or procurement agreement with a deadline and penalty.

classes.name: Trader
classes.description: The player or an NPC counterparty on the regional market.

classes.name: Shipment
classes.description: Goods in transit between regions. Pays fuel and takes flight time.

relations.name: owns
relations.description: The player who holds the planet.

relations.name: placed-in
relations.description: The book that holds the order.

relations.name: binds
relations.description: The holder who accepted the contract.

relations.name: fulfils
relations.description: A shipment that delivers against an accepted contract.
